title: Fixing the program
starting_code:
# One move in this program is wrong. Find it and fix it!
wizard.move_up()
wizard.move_left()
wizard.move_down()
wizard.move_down()
hints: Read the comment to see what you need to do.
Watch the first instruction closely to see if it goes the right way.
Change the first instruction to the `move_left` method so that your wizard goes the right way.
intro: I wrote a program to reach that mark, but I think something is wrong! Your wizard bumps into the grassy bank. Can you find the wrong move and fix it?
outro: You fixed it! Reading comments really helps to understand a program.
learned: Now you know what a comment is, and that a note in a program can tell you what to do.
